atoms.b: ((++Semi-colons Colons)) (;) are most often used to join two independent clauses.
While a colon places ((++greater less)) emphasis on the second clause, a semi-colon brings together clauses of ((++equal different)) importance.
Semi-colons can also be used in a list or series which already has punctuation to make divisions ((++clearer less_clear)).

Kira never plays dodgeball; with us she finds it boring.
